Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.storage

Class AbstractRepository<T,ID>

java.lang.Object
com.skyblockexp.ezframework.storage.AbstractRepository<T,ID>
Type Parameters:
T - the entity type
ID - the identifier type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<T,ID>
public abstract class AbstractRepository<T,ID> extends Object implements Repository<T,ID>
Convenience base class for repositories that use a StorageProvider. Subclasses must implement simple serialization hooks `toMap`/`fromMap` and provide an ID-to-path mapping.
